facts.fact: 2424.mg reports that the law on e-money institutions (EME) is applied by the CSBF, which under it issues regulatory instructions, grants or withdraws licences and audits EMEs; the BFM governor announced audits of EMEs on 2026-06-11 after user complaints.
facts.system: Loi sur les établissements de monnaie électronique

facts.fact: 2424.mg reports that under the EME law the CSBF grants and withdraws licences of e-money institutions, which are audited and held to consumer-protection duties such as a 24/7 customer service; the article names no institution.
facts.system: Loi sur les établissements de monnaie électronique
